invariants.identity: citizen identity is bound to runtime and continuity ids by an ed25519-signed identity binding; append, checkpoint, lifelog, and restore paths verify the binding before access
invariants.memory_append: memory events append to the bound continuity id with exact next sequence and predecessor hash
invariants.continuity_owner: each continuity id is owned by one signed citizen/runtime/signing-key tuple and fails closed on same-continuity owner substitution
invariants.checkpoint: checkpoint snapshots retain accepted-through, head hash, public fact summary, and private-state reference ids
invariants.lifelog: lifelog projections expose only allowed visible fields and event hashes; private-state refs are redacted
invariants.recovery: restored ledgers refuse mismatched citizen/runtime/continuity identities, preserve checkpoint summaries across the next checkpoint, and require the expected head before continuing

negative_tests: forged identity binding rejected before memory append
forged identity binding rejected before checkpoint, lifelog, and restore
same-continuity different-citizen or different-runtime owner substitution rejected
restored checkpoint summary is preserved across the next checkpoint
residual_risks: This proof does not authorize Runtime v3 as the default runtime.
This proof does not delete Runtime v2.
This proof does not claim Runtime v2 raw identity or memory wire-format compatibility.
Broader production-like soak and shared live fixture expansion remain routed through #5253.
